input.quote: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated
input.rationale: Section 4.1 gives each Party a convenience exit on ninety (90) days' notice with the notice specifying any termination date, so it is not limited to the end of the then-current term and HDI can walk away mid-term; that fails the fallback element requiring Vendor convenience termination only at term end (the Customer 60–90 day notice and the Vendor 90-day notice elements are already met). Section 4.2(a) also imposes on us an uncapped early-termination fee equal to half of twelve months' Net Sales less $800,000, far above the fallback cap of three months of fees. We therefore target the fallback: cap the Termination Payment at three months of Section 3 fees (leaving the existing zero-floor and instalment machinery intact) and tie HDI's termination to the end of the then-current term.

proposal.summary: Cap the Termination Payment at three months of fees and limit HDI's convenience termination to the end of the then-current term.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We accept the mutual ninety (90) days' notice, but our playbook fallback caps any early-termination fee at three months of fees and permits HDI to exit for convenience only at the end of a term, so we have capped the Termination Payment and tied HDI's termination to the end of the then-current term.
